title: Nicotinamide Riboside Attenuated Cell Damage Induced by the MT-ND4 (G11778A) Mutation
design: preclinical (in vitro 661W photoreceptor cell study and in vivo MT-ND4 mouse model)

outcomes.name: Cell death and apoptosis (661W photoreceptor cells, galactose conditions)
outcomes.effect_text: NR mitigated cell death and apoptosis

outcomes.name: Pattern ERG (MT-ND4 mice)
outcomes.effect_text: ameliorated pattern ERG impairments in MT-ND4 mice

outcomes.name: Oxygen consumption rate (OCR) (661W cells with R340H mutation)
outcomes.effect_text: attenuated the reduction in oxygen consumption rate (OCR)

outcomes.name: Reactive oxygen species (ROS) levels (661W cells with R340H mutation)
outcomes.effect_text: attenuated the increase in reactive oxygen species (ROS) levels

outcomes.name: Antioxidant capacity (CAT activity, SOD levels, GSSG)
outcomes.effect_text: decreased catalase (CAT) activity, superoxide dismutase (SOD) levels, and glutathione disulfide (GSSG), all of which were restored by NR administration
